description: Change how the business's printed QR codes look. Only the fields you pass change. The code color must be darker than the background with enough contrast to scan — rejected otherwise. `reset: true` restores the default look.

accent.description: Frame color: caption text, card fill

cta.description: Optional text above the code, e.g. "Scan to order". null = none (only the name is printed)

eye_style.description: Corner markers: square, rounded or circle

frame.description: none (code + label only), caption (call-to-action text above the code) or card (filled color card around the code)

logo.description: Put the business logo in the middle

show_label.description: Print the table's name under each per-table code (default true). Only turn off for stickers fixed to their table: on a stand that can move, an unnamed code sends orders to the wrong table

name: update_qr_design
title: Update qr design
